what_happened.line: The Stormwater Task Force agreed to hold its briefing to the select board on the stormwater utility until after the town elections, or until the select board has met once afterward.

Most of the meeting went to the school committee's 17 questions about the proposed stormwater demonstration project at the middle/high school; answers will be emailed to Jenny before going to the school.
Members noted that school committee members seemed unaware that permit fines could follow if no demonstration project is built; the presenter said he had mentioned it.
The task force approved its prior minutes, and changes to the outreach presentation were made, with an appendix to be emailed to the team.
No public comment was heard; someone had planned to speak but left no statement.

why_it_matters: A stormwater utility, which would be a new charge that could reach tax or fee bills, will not be put before the select board until after the elections, so voters will not see the task force's case before they vote.

The school's demonstration project is tied to permit requirements, and the minutes record that fines are possible if none is built, so the school committee's decision on it may carry a cost to the town either way.
